common_discipline.m1a: Every M1A case inherits: fresh command identity; fresh record identity unless the cited upcoming ID is unused; exact current projection version/digest; valid closed/sorted shapes; independent canonical record, payload, candidate and command digests and matching synthetic authority attestation. Keep exact goal/plan/task/packet refs and current actor/role/allowed-command/lease/time/policy bindings except the isolated relation. Advance logical time only as needed within half-open lease and authority windows. Resolve dependencies and reseal transitively; never change already admitted immutable bytes. Identify the precise earliest failing guard. No real credential or authority is involved.
common_discipline.formal: Keep exact baseline text/config/one-site mutation and explicit bounds in separate artifacts. Independently derive action preconditions, transition effects, invariants and temporal obligations from the cited contract. Expected semantics cannot be generated by the target as its own oracle. Capacity truncation, deadlock-check suppression and omitted fairness must be visible. No checker or target import occurred in this drafting task.
m1a_evidence: exact prefix and independently authored mutated/control inputs plus resealing/reference ledger
preregistered semantic oracle and error-code decision where needed
raw receipts/events/full before-and-after projections and unchanged caller inputs
case verdict with reviewer and limitations
formal_evidence: source/config hashes and exact site identity
raw trace or proof/checker report if later authorized
common_discipline.prefix_validity: Independently validate every reused active-state prefix and each positive control against the chosen whole wire contract. Admission/replay acceptance of a structurally valid but wire-inconsistent prefix is producer-diagnostic only, not an otherwise-valid isolated semantic counterexample. Any regenerated fixture needs a distinct source/seed regime, exact hashes, transitive resealing and independent verification of every prefix step. Preserve all historical bytes and guards; if target code changes, separate baseline and revision evidence and show that the tested missing-guard relation was not repaired or masked.
